old: One bus ticket costs ₹12. Lalit has ₹100. What is the greatest number of tickets he can buy?
new: One bus ticket costs ₹12. Lalit has ₹99. What is the greatest number of tickets he can buy?
why: 100 ÷ 12 with remainder breaks the C3 ceiling (remainder only with a 2-digit dividend); ₹99 keeps key C (8)

old: 8 × ₹12 = ₹96 and 9 × ₹12 = ₹108. He can buy 8 tickets and has ₹4 left.

why: Match ₹99 stem; no sentence starts with a numeral
